pr.merge.title: Gate and merge the pinned head
pr.merge.summary: Run the merge gate, squash merge exactly its verified head, then read back GitHub state. MERGED exits 0; gate refusal, HEAD_MOVED or MERGE_REFUSED exit 1; MERGE_UNVERIFIED exits 2 and requires pr.state before further action. Keeps gate evidence, head and receipt in result.

pr.state.title: Read pull request state
pr.state.summary: Read current-head GitHub checks, threads, merge readiness and remarks. Prints one JSON line with verdict, news and an opaque next token; --since suppresses unchanged reads. Read failures exit nonzero without advancing the token.

check.gate.title: Check merge evidence
check.gate.summary: Read fresh GitHub pull request evidence and require a verified current-head PASS receipt, successful required checks, zero unresolved review threads, and no configured door paths. PASS exits 0; REFUSED exits 1 with reasons in result.

check.run.title: Run declared checks
check.run.summary: Run declared checks. PASS exits 0; FAIL exits 1; INCOMPLETE or NOT_EXECUTED exits 2. Non-PASS returns ok:false (MCP isError:true) with the full receipt in result. Retain it on nonzero exit; inspect result.runs and repair commands, environment or timeout. Requires a first Git commit.

check.list.title: List declared checks
check.list.summary: Read the configured command names without launching commands.

check.show.title: Show check evidence
check.show.summary: Read and verify one accepted receipt; use the id returned by check run.

examples.command: POSIX: forge check show --id "$(forge check run | node -pe 'JSON.parse(require("fs").readFileSync(0,"utf8")).result.id')"
PowerShell 5.1: forge check show --id ((forge check run | ConvertFrom-Json).result.id)
